Our reviews include examining each setting of your LOS (Encompass®, BytePro, Meridianlink) and other technologies used throughout your workflow. Maximize the performance of your entire company with our dedicated Workflow and Technology Reviews, designed to empower your organization by identifying opportunities for improvement. We deliver a report with a task list of what you need to do. If you need help getting it all do, we are here to help. Diagnose for Excellence Proactively spot and solve system glitches so technical hiccups never slow you down. Risk Evaluation Conduct thorough risk assessments to safeguard your processes against potential financial discrepancies and operational oversights. Customized Solutions Create milestone templates and design custom input forms that fit your business's unique needs, making your LOS workflow effective. Policy Integration Add and manage complex business rules with ease, ensuring compliance and smooth operations across all stages of loan processing. Usage Monitoring Keep a diligent eye on your system usage to optimize performance and anticipate needs before they become urgent. Process Re-engineering Transform your mortgage operations with redefined processes to minimize processing times and maximize client satisfaction. Our approach is thorough, targeting the core of your system to propose modifications that streamline your mortgage workflow. Advanced Technology Strategies Personalize your system workflows to align perfectly with your team's operational needs, ensuring peak efficiency and a smooth lending process. We evaluate how your staff interacts with Encompass®, identifying key strategies to boost productivity and streamline task flow. Productivity Optimization Receive a strategic roadmap of ongoing enhancements with clear, actionable steps to maintain and improve operational excellence over time. Efficiency for Everyone We engage with every department in your organization, from leadership to front-line teams, to understand your processes thoroughly. We securely document every interview and note in your Client Portal for easy access. Based on our findings, we deliver customized, actionable recommendations designed to streamline your workflows, & upgrade your technology. Encompass Admin We conduct a thorough analysis to ensure your Encompass platform is configured to maximize efficiency and productivity. From streamlining workflows to implementing security measures, we provide tailored recommendations to enhance your Encompass administration. Secondary We evaluate your secondary market operations to identify areas for enhancement, such as integrating more tasks into Encompass to reduce reliance on email communication and resolving issues with loan data accuracy. Compliance We help create document templates from eFolders to simplify document export and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Additionally, we review workflows for fee disclosure against industry standards and provide recommendations for enhancing compliance practices. Retail Group We focus on streamlining operations and improving communication channels. We identify opportunities to eliminate paper-based processes, such as transferring LO paperwork, and recommend changes to enhance live LO transfer procedures. Underwriting We assess the existing workflow and recommend implementing dashboards to improve the monitoring and control of loans in the underwriting pipeline. Additionally, we suggest developing and utilizing automated conditions to streamline underwriting tasks and enhance efficiency. Post-Closing We recommend leveraging technology to manage trailing documents and post-purchase issues effectively. Additionally, we suggest creating dashboards to monitor and track trailing documents, ensuring timely resolution and compliance. Partner with us to secure your position as a leader in the competitive mortgage lending market. Precision System Audits & Process Re-engineering Discover the untapped potential of your Encompass® Loan Origination System with our in-depth Workflow and Technology Review. Our services begin with: Comprehensive System Audits : We meticulously investigate your current Encompass® setup to uncover opportunities for enhancement, focusing on improving both efficiency and regulatory compliance. Process Re-engineering : Transform your mortgage operations with redefined processes, engineered to minimize processing times and maximize client satisfaction. Our approach is thorough, targeting the core of your system to propose modifications that streamline your entire mortgage workflow. Advanced Technology Strategies & Productivity Optimization Elevate your lending operations with strategic technology utilization and productivity optimization for your Encompass® system. Our expert services include: Technology Utilization Strategies : Harness the full capabilities of Encompass® with our guidance to fully leverage its comprehensive features and tools. Workflow Customization : Personalize your system workflows to perfectly align with your team’s operational needs, ensuring peak efficiency and a smooth lending process. Productivity Assessments : We evaluate how your staff interacts with Encompass®, identifying key strategies to boost productivity and streamline task flow. Continuous Improvement Plans : Receive a strategic roadmap of ongoing enhancements, with clear, actionable steps to maintain and improve your operational excellence over time. Partner with us to refine your technology and workflows, securing your position as a leader in the competitive mortgage lending market. Complete Solutions for your Encompass® Admin Needs by Certified Administrators Our dedicated Encompass Admins, certified by Ellie Mae (now a part of ICE Mortgage Technology), provide on-demand services for your needs. Each of our system admins is an integral part of our Support and Services team, which includes our other Encompass Mortgage Software Admins, Consultants, and Developers, so if any of our resources at your company are stuck with anything unusual, they have quick access to the answers and solutions from the mortgage tech experts. Our Admins can be your main Encompass administrator or provide backup support to your existing Encompass360 tech staff. This means you get professional guidance for your lending operations without dealing with recruitment processes, contracts, and onboarding expenses. ATI is here to fulfill your needs for reliable, top-notch, and result-oriented Encompass admin assistance at low costs. Encompass Administrator Service Packages We offer Encompass Admin Services with different packages designed to meet your unique requirements without the burden of hiring a full-time resource. Choose a system administrative plan that aligns with your business goals and enjoy efficient, cost-effective, and customized Encompass administrative solutions. 1. On-Demand Administration Support If your mortgage business requires a responsive solution, our on-demand Encompass admin support is a perfect choice. Access our administrative service whenever you have tasks that demand immediate attention, ensuring a quick and efficient response. 2. Hourly Admin Consultation Does your business need occasional assistance or have infrequent administrative tasks? Our Hourly Consultation package allows you to engage our Encompass administrator services on an as-needed basis. Pay only for the hours you use, providing you with cost-effective flexibility. 3. Admin on Contract Opting for our Encompass Admin on Contract package means you get dedicated administrative support over a specified duration. This commitment ensures a seamless integration of administrative functions into your workflow, allowing for sustained efficiency. 4. Monthly System Admin Ensure continuous and reliable Encompass360 administrative assistance with our Monthly Support package. It's a subscription-based model that provides consistent End-User support throughout the month, allowing you to focus on your core business operations.. 5. Virtual System Admin Services Embrace the future of remote support with our Virtual Encompass Assistant Services. Our certified Encompass developers and administrators will handle a range of tasks from a remote location, so there's no interruption in your office premises. 6. Project-Based Administration Encompass® Admin Services customized to your specific projects or initiatives. This flexible approach allows you to access our Encompass administrative assistance precisely when and where you need it, ensuring project success without needing a full-time admin resource. User Administration Administer company and user setups, roles, and personas. API/SDK Developer on Demand Provide services to convert SDK to next-gen API conversions and API integrations. An Encompass System Admin has several responsibilities, including: Providing advanced support to users and third-party vendors and handling high-level tasks. Implementing system changes, including updates, customizations, and configurations. Managing company and user setups, roles, and personas. Overseeing best practices in data governance, quality management, & data sharing. Generating reports and addressing support issues. Focusing on automation and development to enhance workflow efficiency. Creating and maintaining documentation on current technology. Supporting organizational initiatives through software development, & maintenance. Analyzing workflow and user interaction for training documentation development.
